summary: Frontend-only UI regression testing for 3 UI changes (delivery time 15–20 jours, remove reviews/ratings, no cart drawer animation on add). All 3 changes verified plus regressions passed.
critical_code_review_comments: ProductCard.jsx still passes full product object (including legacy rating/reviews fields) to cart via addItem — harmless but cart items in localStorage retain 'rating' and 'reviews' keys. Consider stripping them on addItem to fully remove reviews concept.
products.js data likely still contains rating/reviews fields (visible in cart localStorage payload). Not user-visible, but for consistency the data source should be cleaned.
seed_data_creation: Seeded cart via localStorage key 'sec_cart_v1' with p1 (Casque Aura Pro) to reach /commande.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: (1) Home Navbar banner + hero + benefits show 'Livraison Chine → Dakar en 15–20 jours'; testimonials section fully removed; no 'avis' text; product cards have no rating line. (2) Boutique sort dropdown only shows Pertinence/Prix croissant/Prix décroissant (no 'Meilleures notes'); no 'Notes' filter; price ascending sort works (12k → 18.5k → 29.5k → 44.5k → 48.5k). (3) PDP /produit/p1 has no stars/avis, 'Livré en 15–20 jours' feature icon present, Livraison tab reads 'Livraison Chine → Dakar en 15–20 jours — offerte dès 30 000 F.' with no '€' and no '24–48h'. (4) Add to cart from card hover and from PDP both fire toast 'Ajouté au panier' WITHOUT opening the cart drawer; cart icon in navbar shows badge count. (5) Manual cart drawer opens, shows item + qty +/− + remove + 'Passer commande'. (6) Checkout /commande 3-step flow: Adresse (placeholders 'Marie','Dupont','Dakar' work) → Livraison shows single option 'Livraison standard · Chine → Dakar / 15–20 jours / Offerte' (no express, no point relais) → Paiement grid loads (Orange Money Sénégal/CI, Wave Sénégal/CI, MTN, Moov, Carte bancaire) with visible 'Code OTP *' field for Orange Money. Payment submission not exercised per instructions.
